x: Bridger will be a big asset next year, as should "Marathon Doub," who surprised everyone with a brilliant performance. Sympathy must be extended to Roberts who after a hectic taxi ride to arrive on time, suffered disqualification.
Bridger, Heather, Thaxter, Roberts, Doubleday, Snell, and others, supporting Bert Clayton, our Eastleigh member, who may win the individual title, is certainly a team of possibilities.

Clayton, Heather, Roberts, Thaxter, Doubleday, Bridger, Goold, Elliott, East, Snell and others have great potentialities, and with conscientious, steady training, we may expect a team which will represent the Club with credit.
The race was slightly marred by the absence of Bridger, Elliott and Speechley, whose presence would most certainly have made the race keener.
